quantize_model_gptq: quantize a HuggingFace causal LM to GPTQ format with specified bits and group size
run_sequential_quantization: run sequential layer-by-layer GPTQ quantization on a model using calibration data from wikitext2
pack_quantized_model: pack quantized weights into QuantLinear layers after GPTQ quantization is complete
get_calibration_loader: get a calibration data loader for wikitext2, ptb, or c4 datasets for GPTQ quantization
find_quantizable_layers: find all quantizable linear and conv layers in a PyTorch model recursively
